project_context.goal: Evolve visual design from sharp minimalist to premium modern (Artem Saykin aesthetic) without altering existing page structure.

buttons.primary: bg-[#DC1C2E] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3.5 font-bold shadow-lg shadow-red-500/20 hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-[#003DA5] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3.5 font-bold shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/20 hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300
buttons.outline: border-2 border-[#003DA5] text-[#003DA5] rounded-full px-8 py-3.5 font-bold hover:bg-[#003DA5] hover:text-white transition-all duration-300
buttons.rules: Never use sharp edges (0px) for buttons. Use sentence case or title case, NO aggressive all-caps for main CTAs.

cards.base: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_12px_40px_rgb(0,0,0,0.08)]
cards.image_treatment: Images inside cards should fill the width, top edges rounded-t-2xl

floating_trust_badge.style: bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md rounded-full px-5 py-2.5 shadow-xl shadow-black/10 border border-white/20
floating_trust_badge.icon: Use a star icon filled with yellow (e.g., text-yellow-400 w-5 h-5)
floating_trust_badge.text: text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 (e.g., '4.6 na základě 90+ recenzí')
floating_trust_badge.placement: Absolute positioned over hero image or agent profile (e.g., bottom-left or bottom-right). Use z-10.

guarantee_ribbon.style: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#003DA5] to-[#002870] text-white rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-8 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-6 shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden
guarantee_ribbon.decoration: Use a bold icon (Shield or Flame). Text example: 'Pokud neprodám, zaplatím vám 30 000 Kč'

layout_and_sections.generous_spacing: Use py-20 or py-24 for section padding. Add breathing room between components.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT rewrite the existing page structure, information architecture, or routing. Keep existing functional files intact, just update styling.
DO NOT change the existing text content heavily unless requested.
Update Buttons: Locate all buttons/CTAs and change their classNames to use rounded-full (pill-shaped) tokens with soft shadows. Remove uppercase text-transform.
Update Cards: Locate all property, agent, and bento cards. Replace sharp 1px borders/0-radius with rounded-2xl, soft shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)], and subtle border-gray-100.
Add Floating Badges: Implement the 'floating_trust_badge' on the Hero section image and Agent profiles as an absolute positioned element.
Add Guarantee Ribbon: Build out the ribbon using the `guarantee_ribbon` tokens provided.
Restyle Stats: Update the 'Čísla, která mluví za mě' stats section to use massive typography for numbers instead of enclosing them in bordered cards.
Apply Alternating Rhythm: Update section background classes (bg-white, bg-gray-50, bg-[#003DA5]) to create a modern pacing down the page.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize optical alignment over geometric alignment.
Never apply universal transition (transition: all), specify properties (e.g., transition-transform transition-shadow).
Do not center-align paragraphs; left-align dense content for readability.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds under text on headers/overlays; use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md) or dark overlays (bg-black/50).
Ensure buttons use micro-interactions (hover, active scale, focus rings).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Use JS/JSX standard Tailwind CSS classes.
